roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and fixed source IQ context have no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch five, no target or pilot-based selection

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent

rows.method: DURA conditional IQ flow with Bernoulli half origin exposure
rows.purpose: Compare explicit deployment-origin exposure to uniformly sampled time, without target feedback
rows.seed_notes: Initialization 2026110612; source fit 2026110611; order 2026110613; flow time 2026110713; evaluation 2026092701
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views

notes: Each source training example independently uses t=0 with probability 0.5, otherwise uniform [0,1); fixed time seed 2026110713.
Linear anchor-to-clean paths, velocity target clean-anchor, four fixed Euler inference steps; 32768 source IDs x three views x five epochs.

At t>0, (path_state-anchor)/t algebraically equals target velocity because source clean defines the training path. This potential shortcut says nothing by itself about learned model behavior or identity performance.
No F/TX/V/target in recovery training; fixed last checkpoint, no target feedback.
All seven 168000-record Phase1 predictions fixed before independent truth-last; compare frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL DURA.
GPU5 queue waits for fewer than three total compute apps and at least 4096 MiB free; preserve other owners.
Technical stop on invalid input, provenance failure, non-finite/OOM, output conflict, smoke, prediction or scoring failure; no automatic retry.
